'''Mikfa Faaus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived near the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He used to repair kitchen refrigerator units and other devices.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he was approached by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] on the advice of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Amyva Va'new]]. The spacer was looking for detailed information about [[Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer|Corellian fried ice cream fryers]] and how they worked. He planned to reverse-engineer a broken fryer and create a schematic that could be used to manufacture a new one.

Faaus did not know much about such fryers, but he gave him the coordinates of a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] named [[Eteto Topan]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that knew more about this device.

==Behind the scenes==
Mikfa Faaus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FonatF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mikfa Faaus was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Portable Deep Fryer|"Portable Deep Fryer" collection]] introduced with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]],"<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67692&month=042008|text=Weekly Picks – 4/3/08 - 04/03/2008}}</ref> published on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
